DatavolumesRequestType.name: requestType
DatavolumesRequestType.description: Which datavolumes would be returned in the response. Originated - datavolumes that are originated in the permitted scopes of the caller. UsableInProject - datavolumes that can be used in a specific project; if you use this value, you must also provide the project ID in the "usableInProjectId" query param.

DatavolumesUsableInProjectId.name: usableInProjectId
DatavolumesUsableInProjectId.description: Only when using "UsableInProject" requestType; Filter results for only datavolumes that are shared with - or originated in - the project.

Offset.description: The offset of the first item returned in the collection.

Limit.description: The maximum number of entries to return.

SortOrder.name: sortOrder
SortOrder.description: Sort results in descending or ascending order.

DatavolumesFilter.name: filterBy
DatavolumesFilter.description: Filter results by a parameter. Use the format field-name operator value. Operators are == Equals, != Not equals, <= Less than or equal, >= Greater than or equal, =@ contains, !@ Does not contains, =^ Starts with and =$ Ends with. Dates are in ISO 8601 timestamp format and available for operators ==, !=, <= and >=.
